items.markdown:
No win, no fee lawyers in Sydney offer `legal representation for personal injury and compensation claims without charging upfront professional fees`.[[1]](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/nsw/sydney-cbd)[[2]](https://www.brydens.com.au/no-win-no-fee/)

### How "No Win, No Fee" Works

- **Professional Fees:** You do not pay your lawyer's hourly rates or service fees if your case is unsuccessful. If you win, fees are paid out of the final settlement or payout.[[1]](https://www.garlingandco.com.au/no-win-no-fee/)[[2]](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/nsw/sydney-cbd)[[3]](https://jamesonlaw.com.au/personal-injury/no-win-no-fee/)[[4]](https://www.national-accident-helpline.co.uk/personal-injury-and-accident-claims/no-win-no-fee)
- **Disbursements (Out-of-Pocket Costs):** Even under a no win, no fee agreement, you may still be responsible for external costs like medical reports, court filing fees, or expert witness fees. Check whether your firm waives these conditionally (some do for dust diseases or specific claims).[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/the-firm/legal-costs/no-win-no-fee)[[2]](https://www.garlingandco.com.au/no-win-no-fee/)[[3]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/about-us/fees/)
- **Adverse Costs:** If you lose court proceedings, you might risk an order to pay the opposing party's legal costs.[[1]](https://www.brydens.com.au/no-win-no-fee/)[[2]](https://www.garlingandco.com.au/no-win-no-fee/)
- **No Percentage Fees:** Contingency fees (taking a percentage of your overall settlement as a bonus fee) are illegal for personal injury claims in New South Wales.[[1]](https://www.garlingandco.com.au/no-win-no-fee/)
